questions.question:
FROM:

TO:

SUBJECT:

SENT:

 Vishal Shah

Finance Office

Travel reimbursement

December 10, 2:11 P.M.
Hello,

I know that I can be reimbursed for certain business trip costs but not others. I kept records of everything I spent while on business for our company in Tokyo. Could you give me the details on the company policy for getting refunds for the money I spent?

Thank you,

Vishal
Directions: Respond to the e-mail as if you work in the finance office. In your e-mail, give THREE details.
questions.model_answer:
Dear Mr. Vishal, Lời chào
The company will refund some food, travel, and hotel costs (thông tin 1). Your manager gave you a budget and you will be refunded according to that budget (thông tin 2). If you spent more, you will not receive refunds for the total amount you spent (thông tin 3).   If you have any other questions, please contact us again. 3 thông tin về chính sách công ty trong việc hoàn tiền: - Công ty sẽ hoàn tiền một vài chi phí về đồ ăn, du lịch và khách sạn. - Quản lý đã cho bạn 1 khoản ngân sách và bạn sẽ được hoàn tiền dựa trên ngân sách đó - Nếu bạn chi nhiều hơn, bạn sẽ không được hoàn tiền cho toàn bộ các khoản bạn đã chi.
Sincerely, Joo-Won Choi Ký tên

questions.question:
FROM:

TO:

SUBJECT:

SENT:

 John Dembo, TMR Industries

Susan Hoffman, TMR Industries

Employee awards dinner

April 5, 6:00 P.M.
Hi Susan,

I’m coordinating the employee awards dinner this year. I know you’ve done this in the past. Can you tell about your experience planning previous dinners? Also, I’d appreciate any suggestions that you may have.

John Dembo
Directions: Respond to the e-mail. In your e-mail, give TWO pieces of information and make ONE suggestion.
questions.model_answer:
Hi John, Lời chào
I always held it in the conference room in order to save money (thông tin 1). There are a lot of good caterers in the area to choose from (thông tin 2). It is best to start at least a month before the dinner so that you have enough time to do everything (gợi ý). - Thông tin 1: Tôi luôn tổ chức ở phòng hội nghị để tiết kiệm tiền - Thông tin 2: Có rất nhiều nhà cung cấp thực phẩm tốt trong khu vực để lựa chọn - Gợi ý: Nên batwss đầu trước ít nhất 1 tháng để có thời gian làm tất cả mọi thứ.
Sincerely yours, Susan Hoffman Ký tên

questions.question:
Do you agree or disagree with the following statement?

To be a good leader, a person must be able to make quick decisions.

Give reasons or examples to support your opinion.
questions.model_answer:
Mở bài I agree that good leaders need to be able to make quick decisions. In business, you do not always have time to get advice or do a lot of research. This is important when there are problems and when clients make last minute requests. Trình bày 2 luận điểm: - Cần đưa ra quyết định khi có vấn đề - Và khi khách hàng đưa ra quyết định vào phút chót
Thân bài 1 (Khi có vấn đề) When problems happen, you usually have to make decisions quickly. For example, if a customer is unhappy, you need to think quickly to fix the situation. When I was a manager at a restaurant, we had a lot of customers who were upset about the food or the service. Even though the food was good and the servers were all very nice, some people just did not like their experiences. I had to think quickly to make them happy. Sometimes I gave them free drinks or appetizers. Other times, I gave people coupons for their next visit. I did not have a lot of time to work through the problems. Other managers were not as good at making quick decisions and those customers ended up leaving bad reviews. - Ví dụ: Khi một khách hàng không vui, bạn cần phải nghĩ cách để xử lý tình huống. Khi tôi là quản lý của một nhà hàng, chúng tôi đã có nhiều khách hàng cảm thấy không vui với đồ ăn hoặc dịch vụ. Mặc dù đồ ăn ngon và phục vụ tốt, có vài người không thích trải nghiệm của họ tại đây. Tôi đã nghĩ cách để làm họ vui, tôi thỉnh thoảng cho họ đồ uống miễn phí hoặc khai vị, có vài lần tôi cho họ phiếu giảm giá. Tôi không có nhiều thời gian để nghĩ sâu về vấn đề và nếu không quyết định nhanh thì khách hàng sẽ để lại review xấu.
Thân bài 2 (Khi khách hàng đưa ra quyết định phút chót) Another reason why good leaders have to be able to make quick decisions is that clients often make requests that need to be addressed immediately. If the leader does not know when to say yes and when to say no, the team members may not be able to complete assignments on time. The leader may agree to something that cannot be done at all or at least cannot be done when the client wants it to be done. This can cause a lot of problems. Conversely, if a leader does not make a decision and respond quickly enough, the company might miss an opportunity - Phân tích: khi leader không biết khi nào nên nói có và nói không, thành viên trong team sẽ không thể hoàn thành công việc đúng hạn. Leader có thể đồng ý với một thứ mà không thể được hoàn thành hoặc ít nhất là không hoàn thành khi khách hàng muốn. Nếu leader không quyết định nhanh và phản hồi kịp, công ty sẽ mất một cơ hội.
Kết bài For those reasons, I believe that good leaders need to know how to make quick decisions. If your leader does not know how to do this, the team members and the company will have a lot of problems. Tổng hợp luận điểm và nêu quan điểm cá nhân.

intro.content:
Question 1-5: Write a sentence based on a picture

Directions: In this part of the test, you will write ONE sentence that is based on a picture. With each picture, you will be given TWO words or phrases that you must use in your sentence. You can change the forms of the words and you can use the words in any order. Your sentences will be scored on

  • the appropriate use of grammar and
  • the relevance of the sentence to the picture

In this part, you can move to the next question by clicking on Next. If you want to return to a previous question, click on Back. You will have 8 minutes to complete this part of the test.

Example

 Sample response: This man is writing in a notebook.

Question 6-7: Respond to a written request

Directions: In this part of the test, you will show how well you can write a response to an e-mail.

Your response will be scored on

  • the quality and variety of your sentence,
  • vocabulary, and
  • organization.

You will have 10 minutes to read and answer each e-mail

Click on Continue to go on.

Question 8: Write an opinion essay

Directions: In this part of the test, you will write an essay in response to a question that asks you to state, explain, and support your opinion on an issue. Typically, an effective essay will contain a minimum of 300 words. Your response will be scored on

  • whether your opinion is supported with reasons and/or examples.
  • grammar,
  • vocabulary, and
  • organization.

You will have 30 minutes to plan, write, and revise your essay.

Click on Continue to go on.
